items.title: Lou Pallo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007
items.q: I’m trying to think of them all but Irving Berlin and people like that. Irving Berlin played just the black keys I understand, is that right?

ctx.x: Three CDs full of these things, and most of those things were not written by performers.

That’s correct. Correct. It was all written by songwriters and that’s all they did. I’m trying to think of them all but Irving Berlin and people like that. Irving Berlin played just the black keys I understand, is that right?
I did hear that. I heard something about he only played in F sharp.
